Senior PHP/Symfony Engineer — Integrations & Automation 
 We are looking for a senior PHP/Symfony engineer to help own and scale our internal business automation platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who has built and maintained complex integrations between ecommerce, ERP, CRM, and other business systems, and who enjoys solving challenging problems involving data synchronization, asynchronous processing, and production reliability.
 You'll work alongside an existing developer to improve architecture, strengthen monitoring and error handling, and build reliable automations that support our ecommerce and sales operations.
 Company Mission 
 Our mission is to help customers save time and money when purchasing commercial kitchen equipment and supplies by providing a customer-centric shopping experience and by leveraging our industry buying power.
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack PHP Developer to own our in-house business automation platform, together with an existing developer. The platform connects our ERP, e-commerce stores and sales tools, keeping customers, orders, leads and product data in sync. Your primary objective is to make it reliable, maintainable and monitorable. Key focus areas are product architecture, data modeling, a Symfony backend with caching, queues and asynchronous processing, integrations, crawling and a React front end. The ideal candidate is an experienced full stack Symfony developer who has built integrations at scale, pays close attention to detail, learns fast and enjoys solving problems creatively. 
 Responsibilities and Duties 
Own the architecture of our automation platform, keeping it maintainable, monitorable and scalable.
Design and maintain the data model behind customers, orders, leads, accounts and products.
Build and run daily sync chains between our ERP, ecommerce stores and sales tools: customer and order sync, lead scoring, account assignment and write-backs.
Integrate with ecommerce platforms through GraphQL APIs, bulk operations and webhooks, and with other systems through REST and SOAP.
Keep syncs reliable despite rate-limited APIs and missing records, and protect write-back data quality.
Build resilient browser automation with headless browsers in Node.js for workflows that have no API, and web scraping behind proxies.
Enrich and categorise product data using AI models, controlling cost and accuracy.
Run Symfony Messenger queues, cron jobs and background workers, handling failed messages quickly.
Keep production healthy with alerts, digests and runbooks, and reduce alert noise.
Build React front end screens for internal users, and automate sales engagement and SEO tasks.
Raise unit and end-to-end test coverage and keep it running in CI.
 Qualifications and Requirements 
At least 5 years of professional software development experience.
A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience building and running integrations and automations with third-party APIs (ERP, ecommerce, CRM and sales tools) at scale.
Proven product architecture skills: designing and running maintainable, monitorable, scalable applications.
Strong data modelling skills and deep experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL) and Doctrine ORM.
Expert knowledge of PHP 8 and Symfony on the back end.
Strong knowledge of caching systems (e.g. Redis).
Hands-on experience with Symfony Messenger or other message queues, and with asynchronous and background processing.
Experience with REST, GraphQL and SOAP APIs.
Experience with web crawling and headless browser automation (Node.js).
Strong experience with a modern JavaScript front end, ideally React.
Automated testing experience, unit (PHPUnit) and end-to-end (Playwright), and CI/CD pipelines.
 Nice to have: 
Experience with ERP or ecommerce platform data models.
Experience with sales engagement or CRM automation.
Knowledge of SEO automation.
Knowledge of foodservice equipment or the wider equipment supply industry.
 Working Hours 
 This is a full-time role, working remotely from anywhere within Europe. Your working hours should overlap with the team between 10:00 and 19:00 Paris time (CET, UTC+1; CEST, UTC+2 in summer).
 Why Work With Us? 
 We believe that what you do and where you work matters. We foster a collaborative and professional environment where you have the opportunity to grow, build meaningful relationships, and see the direct impact of your contributions on our shared success. You will shape a platform that the whole business relies on every day.
 Perks and Benefits 
Fully remote work from anywhere within Europe.
Ambitious and challenging work that stretches your skills.
A creative environment where new ideas are welcome.
